messages:
Jordan (PM): Heads up — Q3 roadmap sequencing sync. Need to map handoffs between Platform, Runtime, DevEx for the Dedicated + Private rollout. Goal: finalize milestone schedule by EOD Friday.

Priya (Eng-Platform): I can share current capacity gating items. Main dev dependencies are: network config for private, GA of autoscaler, and model rollback hooks. We need Runtime ETA to size autoscaler.

Luca (Eng-Runtime): Working on KV cache persistence + hot-reload. ETA for initial patch: 2 weeks. Hot-reload for model variants: 4 weeks. Will need Platform to expose health-checks by then.

Maya (Design): We'll need 2 sprints for UX polish on rollout flow (canary UI + rollback). Can compress to 1 sprint if we defer analytics hooks.

Sam (DevEx): Docs/SDK changes: function-calling opts and new error codes. I estimate 8 docs PRs, 1 week to publish. Can ship stubs earlier.

Aisha (Sales): We're committed to a pilot with Finco—customer deadline mid-Aug. They need private deployment and custom SSO. That constrains scope.

Jordan (PM): Ok capturing constraints. Proposed approach: (1) Lock core infra (autoscaler + healthchecks) -> (2) Runtime release (KV + hot-reload) -> (3) UX + DevEx + Docs -> (4) Pilot enablement.

Jordan (PM): Quick sanity table:
```
Milestone                     Owner            Target
Infra: autoscaler + health    Priya            2026-07-15
Runtime: KV + hot-reload      Luca             2026-07-29
UX: rollout + canary UI       Maya             2026-08-05
DevEx + Docs                  Sam              2026-08-12
Pilot enablement (Finco)      Platform/Sales   2026-08-19
```

Priya (Eng-Platform): Can we make autoscaler earlier if Runtime provides mock health endpoint? Might move to 2026-07-08.

Luca (Eng-Runtime): I can add a temporary health endpoint this week. That'll unblock autoscaler testing.

Maya (Design): If we cut analytics to post-launch, I can finish UI by 2026-07-29.

Aisha (Sales): Finco needs SSO earlier — is there overhead for SSO integration parallel to infra work?

Priya (Eng-Platform): SSO (SAML) work depends on security infra but can run in parallel with autoscaler. Platform + Security pairing needed. Recommend kickoff this week.

Jordan (PM): Action items:
- @Luca: add temp health endpoint by Thu.
- @Priya: start autoscaler infra with mock health test by Mon.
- @Maya: scope analytics for post-launch; aim UI by 7/29.
- @Sam: draft SDK/PRs stubs this week.
- @Aisha: sync Finco SSO requirements; introduce Security lead to thread.

Sam (DevEx): I'll post a docs roadmap doc link once stub PRs are up. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment check: no active deploys in target window 2026-07-01 -> 2026-08-31 :white_check_mark:

Jordan (PM): Thanks—I'll update the roadmap doc and send calendar invites for a weekly checkpoint. If anything slips, escalate here early. :eyes:
